content.value_statement: Slow Python services waste compute and hide bottlenecks. This skill guides profiling, benchmarking, memory tuning, and targeted optimization.
actual_capabilities: Explains CPU profiling with cProfile, pstats, line_profiler, and py-spy.
Shows memory analysis patterns with memory_profiler, generators, weak references, and __slots__.
Compares faster Python idioms such as comprehensions, joins, sets, dictionaries, and caching.
Covers async I/O, multiprocessing, batch database writes, and query planning examples.
Provides benchmarking methods, common pitfalls, and a performance checklist.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, but does not run profilers automatically.
Benchmark examples need adaptation before use in production code.
It cannot diagnose live systems without code, metrics, traces, or profiler output.
Performance gains depend on workload, data size, runtime, and deployment environment.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Slow Application Paths
use_cases.description: Find hot functions, memory pressure, and slow I/O before changing implementation details.

use_cases.title: Improve Data Processing Jobs
use_cases.description: Select better data structures, batching, generators, multiprocessing, or NumPy for large workloads.

use_cases.title: Review Performance Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Check proposed optimizations against measured evidence, readability, and regression test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Bottlenecks
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a slow function or script.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Python function for likely performance bottlenecks. Explain what to measure first, what profiler to use, and what changes are safest.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Profiling Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a profiling plan for this Python service. Include CPU, memory, I/O, benchmark inputs, success metrics, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Data Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate tuning for a large batch job.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Python data pipeline and propose targeted optimizations. Consider data structures, batching, generators, caching, multiprocessing, and memory usage.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Production Optimization
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a proposed performance change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this performance optimization proposal. Compare expected speedup, operational risk, benchmark design, rollback plan, and missing evidence.

output_examples.input: A slow endpoint performs repeated database writes and has no benchmark results.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend profiling the request path, batching writes, measuring query plans, and adding before-and-after latency benchmarks.

output_examples.input: A script builds large lists while processing a file line by line.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest memory profiling, iterator-based processing, generator expressions, and peak memory validation.

output_examples.input: A team wants to speed up many independent CPU-heavy calculations.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare sequential execution, multiprocessing, NumPy options, benchmark design, and readability tradeoffs.

best_practices: Profile first, then optimize the measured hot path.
Keep benchmarks reproducible with representative inputs and clear success metrics.
Balance speed, memory, readability, and operational risk before merging changes.
anti_patterns: Optimizing code paths that are not measured bottlenecks.
Replacing clear code with complex micro-optimizations without benchmarks.
Comparing performance results from different machines, inputs, or runtime settings.

faq.question: Does this skill run profiling tools for me?
faq.answer: No. It gives guidance, examples, and review criteria for using profiling tools effectively.

faq.question: Which Python profilers does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers cProfile, pstats, line_profiler, memory_profiler, py-spy, and pytest-benchmark patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with memory leaks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes memory profiling, generator usage, weak references, and object memory reduction patterns.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill for code review?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex can use it to review performance claims, benchmark plans, and risky optimizations.

faq.question: Can Claude Code apply these recommendations?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude Code can use the checklist and examples while editing Python projects.

faq.question: Is it only for web applications?
faq.answer: No. It also applies to scripts, data pipelines, database work, and CPU-heavy Python workloads.
